title: Couret-Unification: Finite Exact Spectral Core on (Z/30Z)× in Lean 4
description: Couret-Unification is a Lean 4 formalization project centered on finite spectral and arithmetic structures modulo 30. The frozen layer contains 0-sorry verified modules, including the finite exact spectral core on (Z/30Z)×, character sums, point-defect spectra, G30 triplet classification, Cayley-spectrum structures, squarefree-density closures, and related audited bridges. Active analytic layers remain explicitly separated and contain documented open obligations. No proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is claimed. RHClaimed = false.
